svg.title: Становая тяга с цепями — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. A weighted barbell deadlift with two HEAVY METAL CHAINS attached by clips to both bar sleeves, one chain at each end. Three-quarter front view. Chains must be unmistakable interlocking oval metal links, each hanging downward to the gym floor. LEFT start: both bar plates rest on floor, more chain links visibly piled on the floor beneath each sleeve, hips and knees flexed, athlete grips bar with straight arms. RIGHT finish: standing tall with bar held against thighs, each sleeve has lifted many more chain links off floor, strands hang vertically with a few remaining loose links at bottom. BOTH chains remain clearly attached to ends in both panels. No rubber bands, cables, rack or blocks. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
